questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

9 ÷ 3 + 1 × 7 - 4 = 0
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 9 ÷ 3 + 1 × 7 - 4 = 0

According to the question, after interchanging the numbers :

Option 1) 9 and 7

9 ÷ 3 + 1 × 7 - 4 = 0 ⇒ 7 ÷ 3 + 1 × 9 - 4 = 0

⇒ __**7 ÷ 3**__ + 1 × 9 - 4 = 0

⇒ 2.33 + __**1 × 9**__ - 4 = 0

⇒ __**2.33 + 9**__ - 4 = 0

⇒ __**11.33 - 4**__ = 0

⇒ 7.33 <span style=&q

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

xx_yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy_zzzzzxx_yyyyzzzz_
questions.solution:
Given series: xx_yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy_zzzzzxx_yyyyzzzz_

Option 1) xxyy→ xx__x__yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy__x__zzzzzxx__y__yyyyzzzz__y__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) yzzy → xx__y__yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy__z__zzzzzxx__z__yyyyzzzz__y__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) xyxz → xx__**x**__yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy__**y**__zzzzzxx__**x**__yyyyzzzz__**z**__ → (It follows the pattern of: xxxyyyyzzzzz - xxxyyyyzzzzz - xxxyyyyzzzzz)

Option 4) xyzy → xx__x__yyyyzzzzzxxxyyy__y__zzzzzxx__z__yyyyzzzz__y__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** All mathematicians are logical thinkers.

**Statement II:** Some logical thinkers are scientists.

**Statement III:** Some scientists are fool.

**Conclusion I:** Some scientists are not fool.

**Conclusion II:** Some logical thinkers are not scientists.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08eff6067ef30c25b6fc2edc2eeab18b807aa778453d63e999084124c01f7279.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some scientists are not fool → Does not follow (As some scientists are fool. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some logical thinkers are not scientists → Does not follow (As some logical thinkers are scientists. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

INDIA : NEW DELHI → The capital of India is New Delhi.

And, 

BANGLADESH : DHAKA → The capital of Bangladesh is Dhaka.

Similarly,

FRANCE : ? → The capital of France is Paris.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer

questions.question:
If A + B means A is the wife of B. A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B. A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B.

If P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M, then how is H related to D?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 $
 –
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Father
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

Given: P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M

P ÷ D → P is the mother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc451ae3ad4164d8da6c14b3e376639e2fd3b6148ae3e36a0dfc67c539e340a.png] 

D $ B → D is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e536581b29f92e3e4185c31da0f354f0737e1cf2700a8ec83f8999e5bc66fbce.png] 

B + H → B is the wife of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37b9da30a67e4e8aac2f980139ba8b594d9e8796152ca73f8fbcaaa09f2214d1.png] 

H × T → H is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/457fee37ca47c7bfbc24dcd5033760d8e99d8a1af0b27895115d90f45fabe248.png] 

T - M → T is the sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d57a2f884c2449314d5077d1dc766eed58daac245eb7d5c3000cb660f9ad24f8.png] 

Thus, H is D's sister's husband or brother-in-law.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
